title: moptimized
description: Several optimization or feature mods I've stumbled upon, all mopped up.
body:
Literally just my own preference of performance and feature mods. Formerly _moptifine,_ for its since largely removed OptiFine parity.

I have been accumulating these mods for a decent while. You could say I've been _mopping them up._

## Featuring:
### Client improvements
The common ones, plus [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/ONZm0H7Y), [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/project/g96Z4WVZ), [Exordium](https://modrinth.com/project/DynYZEae), and more.

There's a mod, [Ixeris](https://modrinth.com/project/p8RJPJIC), that's been observed to improve framerates by 10 times. It improves upon **event polling.** What the hell, man?

### Integrated server improvements
[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/project/gvQqBUqZ)\* and [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/project/uXXizFIs), as well as [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/project/VSNURh3q)\*, [Chunky](https://modrinth.com/project/fALzjamp)\*, [ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/project/Ps1zyz6x), etc. They go well with [e4mc](https://modrinth.com/mod/qANg5Jrr)\* if you're not familiar with hosting dedicated servers.

\*SP only

### Far too many QOL mods
Too much to briefly list here, but there's mods that alter the [inventory](https://modrinth.com/mod/aC3cM3Vq), [HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/EsAfCjCV), [chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/MOqt4Z5n), even [error handling](https://modrinth.com/mod/yM94ont6)!

### Features for days
Fancify your [models](https://modrinth.com/mod/4I1XuqiY)! Fancify your [textures](https://modrinth.com/mod/BVzZfTc1)! Take in the [sights](https://modrinth.com/mod/fxxUqruK) and [sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/qyVF9oeo) (and your [friends' sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/9eGKb6K1)), and immerse yourself in them [in virtual reality](https://modrinth.com/mod/wGoQDPN5)!

## To MP, or to SP
**MP is best for multiplayer only.** I personally never play solo (and when I do it's on a self-hosted server), so I trimmed the fat and removed every mod that was solely there to speed up the integrated server.

**SP is for single- and multiplayer.** Singleplayer is still a really big deal to most everyone, so why deny them those performance improvements? This version of the pack has the trimmings added back in.

## DISCLAIMERS:
- Included are **only** the mods, no mod configs. You'll have to tweak everything to your liking.
- This pack is incredibly bloated, boasting **64 (or 73!) mods.** Good luck tweaking everything to your liking.
- Debugify's fix for MC-267376 causes VR mode to crash the game. Make sure to disable the former.
- Enabling Exordium causes the HUD to vanish in VR mode. Just turn Exordium off before entering a world.
- **I cannot provide additional support.** Surely you'll figure something out. Please do.

Props to the masses of Modrinth, as well as the people behind the [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/project/1KVo5zza) pack, and LambdAurora (maintainer of [this fine list](https://optifine.alternatives.lambdaurora.dev/)), for providing such bountiful resources to mop through.
